name: Memory
description: Learn lasting preferences, remember what you ask, and find, change or forget it later.
abilities: Remembers a preference or fact when you ask it to
Learns grounded, non-sensitive preferences from your own messages when automatic learning is on
Finds what it remembers, and changes or forgets it when you say
Uses a project's or library's own memory in its chats when it has one
permissions: Automatic learning saves only new, non-sensitive preferences grounded in your current message; other changes ask or need approval
Nothing from a temporary chat is remembered
Agents with memory off don't use it
Use Saved Memories and Learn Automatically can be switched off in Settings > Memory

changes.notes: Account memory controls and bounded, evidenced automatic learning. Explicit saves and scoped memory remain available.
First release: memory you can search, save to, change and forget from a chat. Manage it all in Settings.
